mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (from_user_id, to_user_id, book_id, content, parent_msg_id, is_read) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{bookId}, #{content}, #{parentMsgId}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT msg_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, book_id, parent_msg_id, content, send_time, is_read FROM message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId}) AND (#{threadId} IS NULL OR parent_msg_id = #{threadId}) ORDER BY send_time ASC

SELECT msg_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, book_id, parent_msg_id, content, send_time, is_read FROM message WHERE (from_user_id = #{userId} AND to_user_id = #{otherUserId}) OR (from_user_id = #{otherUserId} AND to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY send_time ASC

SELECT x.other_user_id AS otherUserId, u.username AS otherName, x.last_content AS lastContent, x.last_time AS lastTime FROM ( SELECT c.other_user_id, m.content AS last_content, m.send_time AS last_time FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN from_user_id = #{userId} THEN to_user_id ELSE from_user_id END AS other_user_id, MAX(send_time) AS last_time FROM message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY other_user_id ) c JOIN message m ON m.send_time = c.last_time WHERE (m.from_user_id = #{userId} AND m.to_user_id = c.other_user_id) OR (m.from_user_id = c.other_user_id AND m.to_user_id = #{userId}) ) x JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = x.other_user_id ORDER BY x.last_time DESC
